source_code_locations: association/training/sequence_position.py: retained members passed to sequence_inputs before computing unchanged anchor target/mask
review_scope: Independent arithmetic from the returned configuration/exposure and 300 scene summaries. No new model forwards, training, raw-array replay or validation/test selection.

reaggregation.unit_count_checks: Every selected weighting checks sum of scene unit_count against corresponding global/component count before mean recomputation. Zero-unit region skips mean computation.
reaggregation.global_scope: Seven methods, four nonempty support regions including all, four weightings, MAE and MSE: 224 numeric equalities. Empty no_predicted_group counts checked; means unavailable.
reaggregation.component_scope: All 38 components plus remaining 170 scenes outside largest component; all region, linear/dropout, four weightings, MAE and MSE.
reaggregation.tolerance: math.isclose rel_tol=1e-11, abs_tol=1e-5; numerical verification only, no scientific significance claim.
reaggregation.quantiles: P95/P99 are cited from reported pooled-array summaries; cannot reconstruct pooled quantiles from scene quantiles.

total_harm_improvement_decomposition.reference: All H/I values use fixed_prior095 on the same V covered-position population.
total_harm_improvement_decomposition.identity: (H_dropout-H_linear)+(I_linear-I_dropout)=(MAE_dropout-MAE_linear)*point_count; additive output-error accounting, not causal mediation.

helper_cohort_semantics: Number of supported helpers at each query in complete frozen V groups, after representative target alignment. A zero-helper query may belong to a sequence containing helpers at other queries; it is not zero helper rows in the entire sequence.

robustness.qualification: Global four point metrics and all four MAE weightings deteriorate, but not every subgroup metric does: outside-largest RMSE and P99 slightly improve. Do not claim every scene, point or metric worsens.

training_intervention.actual_loss_coefficients_after_dropout: UNAVAILABLE in returned aggregates: per-sample retained support counts and original valid-point denominators from full successful training JSONL are needed. These frequencies do not equal the per-anchor/batch objective coefficients audited by084.
unchanged: full V groups and physical inputs
training_intervention.pairing_evidence_boundary: Frozen server checker reports exact initial tensors, sampler/torch RNG and 4000 original batches plus augmentation replay. Full local checkpoint/JSONL/NPZ replay was not performed.

design_implications.claim: Current p=.5 dropout fails the frozen screen; close this recipe without new seed or probability sweep.
The global net penalty is dominated by lost improvement, while anchor-supported-region deterioration is almost entirely increased harm.
Keep complete evidence and physical prior fixed in new representation controls; predeclare helper-supported recovery I and anchor-supported H diagnostics.
083 does not identify temporal helper correspondence as the cause, and does not prove which prior/information/optimization change produced the failure.
087 may test explicit correspondence with matched architecture, full evidence sets and unchanged physical inputs; winning the destructive control alone is insufficient without beating strong072C.

known_limits: Single training seed and reused V300/shared identities; scenes/components are not independent training repetitions.
No raw full-array quantile or checkpoint/log replay locally; server raw files retained under original-registration.
Output H/I decomposition is not a causal intervention on those quantities.
Visible support counts and correctness audit do not establish helper reliability.
Training dropout changes prior, feature information and contamination together.
No attribution of high gradient clipping to failed learning without a controlled optimization comparison.
T_test remains sealed; no new diagnosis or training was executed on server.

receiving_local_review.interpretation: Arithmetic verified; not causal mediation. External implementation 3b7f34c and test counts were not available to this checkout; local implementation/test evidence recorded separately.

later_source_package.status: bundle verified and checked out in an isolated temporary clone; local implementation reviewed against it
later_source_package.boundary: external test counts not claimed as local results; no new server experiment results
